SESSION_ID.description: Your WhatsApp session ID (starts with HAYWHY_MDX! )

DEVELOPER_NUMBER.description: WhatsApp number that receives HAYWHY MDX developer connection alerts (without +)

DEVELOPER_ALERTS.description: Enable developer notifications when a customer bot connects (true or false)

BOT_MODE.description: Command access mode: public or private

GURU_API_KEY.description: Optional Guru API key for guru-mp3, guru-mp4 and screenshot

MONGODB_URI.description: MongoDB connection URI for the bot database

NETWORK_API_URL.description: Base URL for the HAYWHY bot network heartbeat API

NETWORK_API_KEY.description: Private API key for the HAYWHY bot network. Keep this secret.

NETWORK_BOT_ID.description: Unique identifier for this bot in the HAYWHY bot network
